title: basicly fragment source
description: A fragment authored as <id>.fragment.yaml, projected into the always-on files.

schema_version.description: Source-format version; bump only when the loader contract changes.

enforced_by.description: Commands/tools that mechanically enforce this rule (§3.1); each must be cited in the body.

token_cost.description: Declared always-on token cost, one entry per surface this source projects to: a target name for a fragment, `listing` for a skill. Authoring metadata, never emitted into projected output. `basicly catalog lint` measures the real cost and fails a declaration that disagrees by more than its tolerance; an absent declaration is reported and not refused until the release named in basicly.catalog_token_cost.REQUIRED_FROM_VERSION, because the catalog schema is a contract other repositories author against. The zero is the informative half - a scoped fragment costs AGENTS.md its whole body and the other always-on files nothing, so one figure would be wrong for two targets out of three.
